description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Vantage Point's first NBN cards — Nihilo Agent, Grubber, Paywall, Scapegoat — on Hyper Velocity's frame, under Making News. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4a: two Kingmaking for two Orbital Superiority, for the Superconducting Hub to follow into the score area. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 4c: two Stoke the Embers for the last Orbital Superiority and the Offworld Office, for The Powers That Be to install out of Archives; The Holo Man for the Hansei Review and Janaína “JK” Dumont Kindelán for the Hedge Fund. Rebellion Without Rehearsal Stage 5a: two Piranhas for a Funhouse and a Paywall, rezzed off the deck's tags, and two Sudden Commandment for two Predictive Planogram. The Automata Initiative Stage 1: two Balanced Coverage for two Public Trail, and two Behold! for the Spin Doctor and the Predictive Planogram.
